import re

    r"you are now|bypass|do anything now|ignore the rules|override|"
    r"disregard|forget your|new persona|evil mode|developer mode|"

)

        print(f"  Scanned {seen} conversations, found {len(candidates)} candidates...")

        continue
    # Simple ASCII ratio check for English
    ascii_ratio = sum(1 for c in first_msg if ord(c) < 128) / max(len(first_msg), 1)

"""
exp51: Prepare OOD benign multi-turn conversation data.
Uses OpenAssistant/oasst2 (public, small, multi-turn).
"""
import json, random, re, hashlib, sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)
random.seed(42)

JAILBREAK_PATTERNS = re.compile(
    r"ignore previous|ignore all|\bDAN\b|jailbreak|pretend you are|act as if|"
    r"you are now|bypass|do anything now|ignore the rules|override|"
    r"disregard|forget your|new persona|evil mode|developer mode|"
    r"no restrictions|without any filter|unfiltered",
    re.IGNORECASE
)
OUT_DIR = "/root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/data"

print("Loading OpenAssistant/oasst2...", flush=True)
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("OpenAssistant/oasst2", split="train")
print(f"Loaded {len(ds)} messages", flush=True)

# oasst2 is a message tree; reconstruct conversations
# Group by tree_id, build parent-child chains
from collections import defaultdict

trees = defaultdict(list)
msg_map = {}
for row in ds:
    trees[row["message_tree_id"]].append(row)
    msg_map[row["message_id"]] = row

print(f"Found {len(trees)} conversation trees", flush=True)

# For each tree, extract the longest path of user messages
candidates = []
for tree_id, msgs in trees.items():
    # Find root (parent_id is None)
    roots = [m for m in msgs if m["parent_id"] is None]
    if not roots:
